headline: Crocobask
title: Crocobask | Muddy Roll Final Form | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Crocobask is the final stage of the Salabask line. Salabask evolves at level sixty two with one Sprout Stone. Crocobask uses Muddy Roll for power sixty four at twenty energy, and its ultimate is Deepwater Croc King. It can swim. Homeland work is Grass level three, Hauling level three and Water level two. It rounds out a very sturdy Grass line. Do you like swamp Aniimo? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Grass three, Hauling three, Water two

description: Crocobask guide: final form of the Salabask line, evolving at Lv. 62 with a Sprout Stone. Muddy Roll (power 64), Deepwater Croc King ultimate and Grass, Hauling and Water Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Crocobask floats like a log, so check before you step on it.
